title: Why Use Machine Learning or Deep Learning

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: So in the last video we covered briefly the difference between traditional programming and machine learning.
cues.zh: 上支影片簡單介紹了傳統程式設計與機器學習的差異。

cues.en: And again, I don't want to spend too much time on definitions.
cues.zh: 再說一次，我不想花太多時間談定義，

cues.en: I'd rather you see this in practice.
cues.zh: 更希望你看到實際運作。

cues.en: And I left you with the question Why would you want to use machine learning or deep learning?
cues.zh: 最後留了一個問題：為什麼會想使用機器學習或深度學習？

cues.en: Well, let's think of a good reason why not.
cues.zh: 想想，有什麼理由不用呢？

cues.en: I mean, if we had to write all those handwritten rules to reproduce Alice's grandmother's roast chicken dish all the time, that would be quite cumbersome, right?
cues.zh: 如果每次都得手寫所有規則，來重現 Alice 奶奶的烤雞料理，會相當麻煩，對吧？

cues.en: Well, let's draw a line on that.
cues.zh: 好，把這個劃掉。

cues.en: Why not?
cues.zh: 為什麼不用？

cues.en: What's a better reason?
cues.zh: 更好的理由是什麼？

cues.en: Kind of what we just said, Right?
cues.zh: 就像剛才說的，對吧？

cues.en: For a complex problem.
cues.zh: 面對複雜的問題，

cues.en: Can you think of all the rules?
cues.zh: 你能想出所有規則嗎？

cues.en: And let's imagine we're trying to build a self-driving car.
cues.zh: 想像我們要打造自駕車。

cues.en: Now, if you've learned to drive, you've probably done so in maybe 20 hours, 100 hours.
cues.zh: 如果學過開車，也許花了二十小時、一百小時，

cues.en: But now I'll give you a task of writing down every single rule about driving.
cues.zh: 現在我給你一個任務，寫下開車的每一條規則。

cues.en: How do you back out of your driveway?
cues.zh: 怎麼從車道倒車出去？

cues.en: How do you turn left and go down the street?
cues.zh: 怎麼左轉，再沿街前進？

cues.en: How do you park a reverse park?
cues.zh: 怎麼停車、倒車入庫？

cues.en: How do you stop at an intersection?
cues.zh: 怎麼在路口停下？

cues.en: How do you know how fast to go somewhere?
cues.zh: 怎麼知道某個地方該開多快？

cues.en: So we just listed half a dozen rules.
cues.zh: 剛才只列了大約六條規則，

cues.en: But you could probably go a fair few more.
cues.zh: 但你大概能繼續想出更多，

cues.en: You might get into the thousands.
cues.zh: 也許會有數千條。

cues.en: And so for a complex problem such as driving, can you think of all the rules?
cues.zh: 對開車這種複雜問題，你能想出所有規則嗎？

cues.en: Well, probably not.
cues.zh: 大概不行。

cues.en: So that's where machine learning and deep learning come into help.
cues.zh: 這就是機器學習與深度學習能幫上忙的地方。

cues.en: And so this is a beautiful comment I like to share with you on one of my YouTube videos is my 2020 Machine Learning Roadmap.
cues.zh: 我想分享一則很棒的留言，來自我的 YouTube 影片〈2020 機器學習路線圖〉，

cues.en: And this is from Yasui.
cues.zh: 來自這位留言者。

cues.en: I'm probably going to mispronounce this if I even try to.
cues.zh: 如果試著念，我大概會念錯。

cues.en: But Joshua Wong says, I think you can use ML So ML is machine learning.
cues.zh: 這位 Wang 姓留言者說：「我認為可以使用 ML」，ML 就是機器學習，

cues.en: I'm going to use that a lot throughout the course, by the way.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這門課會經常用到這個縮寫，

cues.en: ML Is machine learning, just so you know, for literally anything as long as you can convert it into numbers.
cues.zh: ML 是機器學習，「只要能轉成數字，幾乎任何事情都能使用」。

cues.en: That's what we said before.
cues.zh: 這就是剛才說的。

cues.en: Machine learning is turning something into computer readable numbers and then programming it to find patterns.
cues.zh: 機器學習，是把東西轉成電腦可讀的數字，再寫程式找出模式。

cues.en: Except with a machine learning algorithm, Typically we write the algorithm and it finds the patterns, not us.
cues.zh: 不過使用機器學習演算法時，通常由我們撰寫演算法，由它找出模式，不是我們自己找。

cues.en: And so literally, it could be anything, any input or output from the universe.
cues.zh: 所以真的是任何東西，宇宙裡任何輸入或輸出。

cues.en: That's pretty darn cool about machine learning, right?
cues.zh: 這就是機器學習很酷的地方，對吧？

cues.en: But should you always use it just because it could be used for anything?
cues.zh: 但只是因為能用在任何地方，就永遠應該使用嗎？

cues.en: Well, I'd like to also introduce you to Google's number one rule of machine learning.
cues.zh: 我也想介紹 Google 的機器學習第一條規則。

cues.en: Now, if you can build a simple rule based system such as the step of five rules that we had to map the ingredients to our Sicilian grandmother's roast chicken dish.
cues.zh: 如果能建立簡單的規則式系統，例如剛才那五條規則，把食材變成西西里奶奶的烤雞料理，

cues.en: If you can write just five steps to do that, that's going to work every time.
cues.zh: 只要寫五個步驟，每次都能運作，

cues.en: Well, you should probably do that.
cues.zh: 那大概就應該這麼做。

cues.en: So if you can build a simple rule based system that doesn't require machine learning, do that.
cues.zh: 所以，如果能建立不需要機器學習的簡單規則式系統，就那樣做。

cues.en: And of course, maybe it's not so very simple, but maybe you can just write some rules to solve the problem that you're working on.
cues.zh: 當然，也許沒那麼簡單，但也許只寫一些規則，就能解決手上的問題。

cues.en: Now, this is from a wise software engineer, which is I kind of hinted at it before Rule one of Google's Machine Learning Handbook.
cues.zh: 這來自一位有智慧的軟體工程師，也就是剛才稍微提到，Google 機器學習手冊的第一條規則。

cues.en: Now I'm going to highly recommend you read through that, but we're not going to go through that in this video.
cues.zh: 我很推薦你讀一讀，不過這支影片不會逐一介紹。

cues.en: So check that out.
cues.zh: 所以去看看，

cues.en: You can Google that.
cues.zh: 可以搜尋，

cues.en: Otherwise the links will be where you get links.
cues.zh: 不然連結會放在提供連結的地方。

cues.en: So just keep that in mind.
cues.zh: 記住這一點。

cues.en: Although machine learning is very powerful and very fun and very excited, it doesn't mean that you should always use it.
cues.zh: 雖然機器學習很強大、很好玩、很令人興奮，也不表示永遠應該使用它。

cues.en: And I know this is quite the thing to be saying at the start of a deep learning and machine learning course.
cues.zh: 我知道，在深度學習與機器學習課一開始，說這件事有點特別，

cues.en: But I just want you to keep in mind simple rule buying systems are still good.
cues.zh: 但希望你記住，簡單的規則式系統仍然很好，

cues.en: Machine learning isn't a solve all for everything.
cues.zh: 機器學習不是解決一切的萬靈丹。

cues.en: Now let's have a look at what deep learning is good for.
cues.zh: 現在來看看深度學習擅長什麼。

cues.en: But I'm going to leave you on a cliffhanger because we're going to check this out in the next video.
cues.zh: 不過先留個懸念，因為下一支影片才會討論。

cues.en: So you soon.
cues.zh: 很快再見。
